lip_sync.method: mouth = inner-lip gap / outer-eye distance (mediapipe FaceLandmarker); vocal envelope = RMS per frame of the Kim_Vocal_2 MDX-Net stem of the song window; r = Pearson, best within +-4 frames; null = same mouth track vs the envelope rolled by >= 2 s
lip_sync.verdict: weak: each shot's mouth follows its own stretch of the song (mean best r 0.247) only a little better than another stretch of the same song (0.183), and the pooled r over the whole cut (0.103) is at the shifted-envelope baseline (0.085). The earlier studio's QA called 0.35 good.

h3_audio_decode.note: What H3's own audio decode of the locked latent sounds like next to the song, per shot. The studio does not ship it: the cut swaps in the original window.
